| ModuleSpec | src/contracts/project_architect.py | One module in a project plan |
| ProjectPlan | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Complete project plan with module DAG |
| ProjectPlanResult | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Result of project planning |
| ProjectArchitect | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Decomposes project spec into module DAG |
| ModuleStatus | src/cli/project_builder.py | Status of a module build |
| ModuleOutcome | src/cli/project_builder.py | Outcome of building a module |
| ProjectBuildResult | src/cli/project_builder.py | Result of building the entire project |
| ProjectBuilder | src/cli/project_builder.py | Drives ModuleArchitect + ModuleTDDBuilder over a ProjectPlan |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant CLI as CLI (main.py)
    participant Factory as TDDRunHandle (factory.py)
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    User->>CLI: ace tdd feature.feature
    CLI->>Factory: build_agent(config)
    Factory->>Runner: IterativeTDDRunner(pod, planner)
    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
    Planner->>LLM: generate(prompt)
    LLM-->>Planner: next test spec
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

    loop RED→GREEN→REFACTOR
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: test code
        Worker-->>Pod: test code string
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult(passed=False)
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult

        alt RED aborted (security/policy)
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed (test fails correctly)
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec)
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            LLM-->>Worker: impl code
            Worker-->>Pod: impl code string
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, impl})
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult

            alt GREEN passed
                Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=True)
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                LLM-->>Worker: refactored code
                Worker-->>Pod: refactored code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, refactored})
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
                Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, output, feedback)
                Reflector->>LLM: analyze execution
                LLM-->>Reflector: insights
                Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curator->>LLM: synthesize bullets
                LLM-->>Curator: delta bullets
                Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, bullets)
                Playbook-->>Curator: added bullet IDs
                Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=True, learned_bullets)
            else GREEN failed (retry)
                Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=False, error)
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                Note right of Cycle: retries up to max_green_attempts
                Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
                alt stagnant failure
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, output, feedback)
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(...)
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                    Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta
                end
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            end
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(cycle_data)
        Runner-->>Runner: check planner for COMPLETE
    end

    Runner-->>CLI: IterativeResult
    CLI-->>User: summary (complete, success, cycles)
```
